_about: The mortgage lender the team introduces buyers to. One source for the prototype's Buy page and ot-core's defaults (Settings > Lender). Facts from the lender's own email to the team (Nov 2026) and his page, https://www.securityfirstmf.com/brian/ (read 2026-11-19). The live site shows the section only once the team records the business arrangement and both REWAP and the lender's compliance team approve it (RESPA section 8, SAFE Act, 209 CMR 42.00, Regulation Z). Never add rates, payments, APRs or loan terms here.
name: Brian Tankersley
title: VP & Sales Manager
intro: When you are ready to talk about preapproval, Brandon and Kaitlyn can introduce you to Brian Tankersley of Security First Mortgage Funding in Shrewsbury. Whether you call Brian or another lender is entirely your choice.
bio: Brian prides himself in providing borrowers with sound advice to help them achieve their financial goals and the dream of home ownership. As Sales Manager, his many years of experience and knowledge provide the team with ongoing support in our ever changing and complex industry.
